processes.meter_flow_missing_deal_resolution: Logistics/measurement staff flag meter flow with no deal, expired deal or zero-volume deal causing allocation exceptions, and ask the desk to set up, extend or fix the deal so volumes can be allocated and paid.
processes.sitara_deal_entry_request: Traders or schedulers ask the desk to create, amend or enter a Sitara deal or ticket (spot, purchase, sale, added meters) with specified counterparty, volume and price.
processes.nomination_change_coordination: Counterparty or internal nomination changes, outages and forwarded nomination files are relayed to schedulers who must adjust nominations and negotiate flow around pipeline outages.
processes.deal_price_invoice_discrepancy: Pricing or invoicing disputes on deals are raised, investigated and corrected between settlements, the desk and counterparties.
processes.volume_discrepancy_reconciliation: Daily volumes disagreeing between pipeline, shippers and HPL, or pipeline shortages, are reviewed and the desk decides which numbers are right and how to bill or buy back.
processes.transport_usage_ticket_maintenance: Monthly updating of transport usage tickets, rates and volumes across pipes so schedulers and position reports are correct.
